prosecution.claim: Three online authorizations under $3 within 40 minutes, then a $259.98 purchase under a product code this card has never used
All four transactions came from a device profile marked New for this account, also seen on closed case CC-0141 (confirmed fraud) and on card C00877-K1 this month
Customer denied making the purchases when asked

defence.claim: Cardholder has transacted online before, so device change alone is not proof of compromise
Billing region is unchanged from the cardholder's normal pattern

evidence_gate.why: Probability 0.62 rests on the pattern alone (R1); the customer's response is the cheapest way to settle whether to block.

rag_context:
POLICY R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal. POLICY R5: Card testing - three or more small online authorizations within an hour, then a larger purchase: recommend DECLINE_TRANSACTION and STEP_UP_AUTH; if a purchase over $100 already cleared, recommend BLOCK_CARD. POLICY R2: Customer denies the transaction - recommend BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; add FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

CLOSED CASE CC-0141 (confirmed_fraud, card_testing): 'Three sub-$3 authorizations at 08:50-09:28 on 2016-08-03, followed by a $214 purchase. Device profile marked New, Android/Samsung browser. Customer denied. Card blocked, case filed.'
